jp_verse: 岩間の泉が　光を抱き\n\n    静かな森へ　歌を流している
en_verse: The mountain spring\nholds the morning light—\nsinging softly through the forest.

jp_verse: 見えない流れが　命を巡り\n\n    深い内側で　静かに働く
en_verse: Invisible currents\nmove quietly through life—\nworking deep within the body.

jp_verse: 谷間を抜ける　細い流れ\n\n    原の光が　朝を開いてゆく
en_verse: A narrow stream\nwinds through the meadow plain—\nopening the morning light.

jp_verse: 草に膝をつき　空を仰げば\n\n    願いは静かに　風へ溶けてゆく
en_verse: Kneeling in the grass,\nthe heart lifts toward the sky—\na prayer dissolves into wind.

jp_verse: 揺れる光の　水底を抜け\n\n    身体は静かに　青へ沈んでゆく
en_verse: Beneath trembling light\nthe swimmer drifts through blue—\nsilent within the water.

jp_verse: 霧深い沼に　波紋が広がり\n\n    誰かの気配だけが　残っていた
en_verse: Across the marsh\nsmall ripples spread through mist—\nonly a lingering presence remains.

jp_verse: 沖へ向かう波は　果てを知らず\n\n    空の広さだけが　道を示している
en_verse: Waves toward the open sea\nknow nothing of endings—\nonly the sky shows the way.

jp_verse: 風を受ける船が　海を渡り\n\n    世界は広く　境を持たない
en_verse: The ship moves onward\nacross the widening sea—\nthe world holds no borders.

jp_verse: 木陰の江を　水が走り\n\n    夕の光が　石に揺れていた
en_verse: Through the shaded creek\nwater runs over stone—\nevening light trembles softly.

jp_verse: 激しい流れが　濁りをさらい\n\n    残るものだけが　静けさを得る
en_verse: The rushing current\ncarries all impurity away—\nwhat remains becomes still.

jp_verse: 湯気立つ椀に　野菜の香り\n\n    寒い夕暮れを　静かに満たす
en_verse: Steam rises gently\nfrom the warm bowl of soup—\nfilling the cold evening.

jp_verse: 指の隙間を　砂が落ち\n\n    時は静かに　形を失う
en_verse: Sand slips slowly\nthrough the open hand—\ntime loses its shape.

jp_verse: 寄せては返す　朝の潮\n\n    海は静かに　岸辺を磨いている
en_verse: The morning tide\nreturns again and again—\npolishing the shore in silence.

jp_verse: 滝の始まりに　澄んだ水\n\n    すべての流れが　ここから生まれる
en_verse: At the waterfall's source\nclear water gathers—\nall rivers begin here.

jp_verse: 光あふれる　渓流の音\n\n    命は静かに　森を満たしてゆく
en_verse: The lively stream\nfills the forest with sound—\nlife moves through everything.

jp_verse: 燃える火に　水が注がれ\n\n    赤い熱だけが　夜へ消えてゆく
en_verse: Water pours softly\nupon the burning fire—\nthe red heat fades into night.

jp_verse: 流れの速さも　光の色も\n\n    その時ごとの　水が決めている
en_verse: The rushing stream\nchanges with light and season—\nwater decides its own condition.

jp_verse: 大きな河は　谷を越えて\n\n    遠い海まで　道を続けてゆく
en_verse: The great river\ntravels beyond the valleys—\ncontinuing toward the sea.

jp_verse: 静かな入り江に　舟を留め\n\n    月だけが　水面を照らしていた
en_verse: The small boat rests\nwithin the quiet harbor—\nmoonlight touches the water.

jp_verse: 風の止まった　朝の湖\n\n    山の姿まで　静かに映している
en_verse: The morning lake\nholds the mountains in stillness—\nnot even wind disturbs it.
